pages.text: This page compresses large setting dumps into an in-game index. It reuses Patchouli, worldpack, market, alchemy, method, item and contribution entries without a new UI.

pages.title: Cultivation Spine
pages.text: Core loop: spiritual power and cultivation exp, roots, lifespan pressure, manual breakthroughs, qi deviation risk and method learning. Methods set direction; spells cover common skills.

pages.title: Economy
pages.text: Spirit stones fund absorption and markets. Contribution, merit and regional tickets gate sects, Tianyuan, Star Palace, Chaotic Sea and realms. The delivery outbox prevents full-bag loss.

pages.title: Craft Stations
pages.text: Alchemy, refinement and talismans use formed stations and operational efficiency. See Station Operations, Talisman/Refinement flows and JEI Authority Recipes. Spirit-gather disks feed free fields.

pages.title: Beasts and Puppets
pages.text: Capture, contracts, feeding, evolution pools and puppet core forges are live. Read the overview and Companion Growth pages.

pages.title: World and Sects
pages.text: Worldpack regions cover Tiannan, Chaotic Sea, Great Jin, Tianyuan, Fengyuan, wilds, Diyuan and Yin Underworld. Thirty sects own specialty methods/discounts/missions; nineteen deep realms are playable.

pages.title: Reading Order
pages.text: Early: realms, stones, pills, talismans, methods. Crafting: stations, outbox, consumables, JEI. Later: secret realms, sect specialties, regional powers and ascension.
